statement: Let G(w)=a w+i b+integral[1/(w-i gamma)-i gamma/(1+gamma²)]mu(dgamma), a>=0,b real,mu positive and integral(1+gamma²)^-1dmu finite. H_epsilon(w)=exp(-integral_0^epsilonG(w+r)dr). For every fixedx>0, lim_epsilon↓0 epsilon^-1 integral|1-H_epsilon(it)|² x dt/[pi(x²+t²)] =2ax+Sum_atoms 2x alpha_gamma[1-Gamma(alpha_gamma+1/2)/(sqrt(pi)Gamma(alpha_gamma+1))]/(x²+gamma²), alpha_gamma=mu{gamma}. The series converges; nonatomic mass contributes0.
hypotheses: Specified compensated positive Herglotz representation; no finite-total-mass, atom-isolation or compact-support assumption. Boundary values are almost-everywhere Fatou values.

statement: Assuming RH, F(w)=xi(1/2+w) defines W_tau f(w)=F(w)f(w+tau)/F(w+tau) as a C0 contraction semigroup on H²(Rew>0). Each tau>0 is compact, injective, quasinilpotent. Its actual generator A has D(A)={f inH²:fprime-(Fprime/F)f inH²}, Af=fprime-(Fprime/F)f, and empty spectrum.
hypotheses: Ordinary Hardy H² norm dt/(2pi), classical completed xi, RH and classical Riemann-vonMangoldt/product inputs. This precise semigroup and maximal domain only.
limitation: Not a proof of RH or obstruction to all spectral realizations.

statement: For the same RH-conditional semigroup and normalized kernel k_z(w)=sqrt(2x)/(w+conj(z)),z=x+i y,x>0, lim_tau↓0 ||W_tau k_z-k_z||²/tau =Sum_distinct_gamma 2x m_gamma[1-binomial(2m_gamma,m_gamma)/4^m_gamma]/[x²+(gamma-y)²]>0. Thus every normalized evaluation kernel lies outside D(A).
hypotheses: Same Hilbert norm and operator as OBS-XW501; multiplicities retained, both signs of ordinates counted separately.

statement: For the same RH-conditional xi semigroup, log||W_tau||=-(tau/2)logtau+(tau/2)(1+log(2pi))+O(logtau) as tau→infinity.
hypotheses: Ordinary Hardy norm and exact operator ofOBS-XW501; fixed normalized evaluation kernel for the lower bound, uniform right-half-plane digamma/Dirichlet-series bound for upper.
